## ProCraft - Pixel in-between (MiniMax H3)

Made for ProCraft Diffusion. Keep this workflow **open in ComfyUI**: the app on your phone gets it as the **ComfyUI (live)** card. On the phone, hold that card and choose **Keep** to keep it for good.

The nodes marked *(from the app)* are filled in by the app: your canvas, your prompt, the selection. **Back to the app** sends the result to your phone. Pressing Run here does nothing useful.
